message: No detected input validation: The code loads data from files and converts it with np.asarray() but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local file paths; there is no remote fetching and therefore no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checking of any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the data preparation code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code loads and preprocesses data without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized data via joblib.load and pickle.load without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity of loaded artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: The code loads and splits data but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous-sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection is present anywhere in the training loop.

No detected differential privacy: Although dp_timegan is imported, the visible training code uses plain optimizers with standard gradient updates and no DP-SGD or privacy-accounting mechanism is evident in the shown code paths.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial stress tests are present in the evaluation code.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads and passes data directly to models without any shape/range validation, schema checks, or rejection of malformed inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks for NaN values, probability sanity bounds, or output range validation are present on the model outputs before they are returned or used.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a time-series GAN pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
